Reflection-pair counting on quadratic residues yields T_p; only c0 and c1 can be wholly singular, with separate tests chi(10)=-1 and chi(5)=1. Exact image sets modulo every power of each good prime, distinguished singular square branches, and their limiting Haar measure constitute a complete, motivated arithmetic classification. The two critical prime-adic lifts require genuine structural analysis beyond the already-known finite-field Dickson cardinality. The natural good-prime range p>=7 arises from denominator 24 and critical-point discriminant 5; no arbitrary slice or claim of downstream application is needed.
